title_en: BUCKET — CORONA, ZENIT & THE FIRST SPY SATELLITES
description: An interactive field guide to the first photo-reconnaissance satellites: the U-2 gap, twelve failed Discoverer launches before a film capsule was caught in mid-air over the Pacific on 19 August 1960, the CORONA panoramic cameras from KH-1 (12 m) to KH-4B (1.8 m), the Soviet Zenit that brought its whole camera home in a Vostok-type capsule, the turn to digital imaging in 1976, and the 1995 declassification that put 860,000 Cold War photographs to work in archaeology and glaciology.
og: Film buckets caught in mid-air: CORONA and Zenit, the first spy satellites — retro-burn, re-entry and air-catch timeline, ground resolution from focal length, film and altitude, and why low perigees made short missions, interactive and checked against declassified figures.
brand: BUCKET — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
